name: io.github.madlabs-tech/onchain-data-mcp
title: Onchain Data MCP
description: Blockchain data for EVM and Solana: balances, tokens, prices, DeFi and RPC via free-tier vendors

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Keeps usage counters and quota state between runs.

environmentVariables.name: ALCHEMY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Alchemy key: EVM RPC, token balances and transfers.

environmentVariables.name: HELIUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Helius key: Solana RPC and token data.

environmentVariables.name: COINGECKO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional CoinGecko key: token prices and market data.

environmentVariables.name: MORALIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Moralis key: wallet history and token data.
